# RUTUBE

> > RUTUBE is Russia's leading video streaming platform offering films, series, music, podcasts, and user-generated content with monetization and offline viewing capabilities.

RUTUBE serves as a Russian alternative to YouTube, featuring popular content like Masha and the Bear (Маша и Медведь), government channels, educational tutorials, and original programming. The platform supports content creators through verification, monetization programs, and tools for migrating from YouTube.

## Key Topics

- RUTUBE platform
- Video streaming and hosting
- Shorts (short-form video)
- Masha and the Bear (Маша и Медведь)
- Channel monetization
- Content moderation
- YouTube migration
- RUTUBE x PREMIER subscription
- Channel verification
- Video embedding
- Offline viewing
- Russian content
- Mobile apps (Android)
- Telegram integration
- Студия RUTUBE (RUTUBE Studio)

## Platform Overview

- [RUTUBE Homepage](https://rutube.ru): Homepage: Russian video platform for films, series, music, and podcasts
- [Main Feed](https://rutube.ru/feeds/new_main_group_d): Main feed: recommendations, trending content, and blogger highlights
- [Video Categories](https://rutube.ru/categories): Video categories catalog: directory of content types on RUTUBE
- [Movies Catalog](https://rutube.ru/feeds/movies): Movies catalog: online film streaming in high quality
- [Ad-Free Viewing](https://rutube.ru/feeds/rk): Ad-free viewing page: cult series, originals, and TV shows

## Creator Resources & FAQ

- [Video Upload Guide](https://rutube.ru/info/upload): Upload FAQ: technical requirements, formats, and Shorts specifications
- [Monetization Program](https://rutube.ru/info/monetization): Monetization FAQ: partner program eligibility and revenue requirements
- [YouTube to RUTUBE Migration](https://rutube.ru/info/youtube): YouTube migration FAQ: transferring videos from YouTube to RUTUBE
- [Channel Verification](https://rutube.ru/info/verification): Verification FAQ: channel authentication and official status requirements
- [Content Moderation](https://rutube.ru/info/moderation): Moderation FAQ: content review process and community guidelines
- [Video Embedding](https://rutube.ru/info/embed): Embed FAQ: how to integrate RUTUBE videos and streams on websites
- [Offline Viewing](https://rutube.ru/info/offline): Offline viewing FAQ: video downloads and RUTUBE x PREMIER subscription

## Featured Channels

- [Masha and the Bear](https://rutube.ru/channel/12217): Masha and the Bear channel: popular Russian animation series for kids
- [Electric Grid Operator](https://rutube.ru/channel/24096838): Electric Grid Operator channel: power system management and training
- [MCHS Yakutia](https://rutube.ru/channel/24764795): MCHS Yakutia channel: fire safety and emergency services in Yakutia
- [Rostrud](https://rutube.ru/channel/25014590): Rostrud channel: Russian labor inspection and public council meetings
- [Village Life (Деревенские Будни)](https://rutube.ru/channel/25821729): Village life channel: hunting, fishing, and Siberian taiga lifestyle
- [Techno Lit](https://rutube.ru/channel/23873695): Techno Lit channel: Russian banya construction and sauna stove reviews
- [Political Commentary (Колхоз дело добровольное)](https://rutube.ru/channel/23347943): Political commentary channel: Ukraine conflict and geopolitics analysis
